execution_assumptions: The specified expression, including signs and repeated terms, defines the required return value.
Inputs can grow; test inputs are finite correctness fixtures, not performance measurements.
No approximation threshold or execution resource budget is supplied.
input_domain: biases are integers; couplings (i,j,w) refer to valid indices and count once per tuple; self couplings and repeated terms are allowed.
software_contract: Return the exact minimum value of the expression computed from biases and couplings over assignments with each entry 0 or 1.
title: Coefficient interface
